_what_this_is: Known findings from scripts/validate-artifacts.py --fixtures that do not fail the build YET. Every entry is a real gap between what a phase emits (as witnessed by a fixture golden) and what its contract document says, with a reason and the fix that would retire it. This file is a burn-down list, not an allow-list: an entry that stops matching anything is reported as STALE_BASELINE so it gets removed. Add an entry only with a reason that names the document or phase that must change.

entries.reason: schema-discover-iac.md:107 says the resource identifier is `address` — 'NOT `id`'. The live-capture seed and the workshop goldens carry `id` anyway. Either discover-live.md is emitting an off-contract key or the doc must admit `id` for live-sourced resources. Decide, fix one side, remove this entry.

Top-level `edges[]` is produced by discover-live / clustering (schema-discover-iac.md:312 describes edges inside clusters only). Add a top-level `edges` entry to the inventory example or move the array under clusters.
Discover stamps `migration_id` on the inventory root; schema-discover-iac.md does not list it. Add to the root example (it is useful provenance) or stop emitting it.
Live discovery writes `metadata.discovery_timestamp`; the doc's metadata example has `report_date` only. Reconcile the two timestamp fields in schema-discover-iac.md § Live discovery extensions.
Live discovery writes `metadata.project` as well as `live_metadata.project`. Document one home for the GCP project id.
Discover stamps `migration_id` on the inventory root; schema-discover-heroku.md does not list it. Add to the root example or stop emitting.
Discover stamps `skill: heroku-to-aws` on the inventory root; schema-discover-heroku.md does not list it. Same fix as migration_id.

discover-live-capture.md captures config var KEY NAMES into app config; schema-discover-heroku.md's addon/formation config tables do not list `config_var_keys`. Add it to the `formation` (or app-level) config schema with the names-only rule stated.
Domain resources carry `config.hostname`; schema-discover-heroku.md documents `domain` resource IDs (line 149) but has no `domain` config block. Add a `### domain config` block.
Domain resources carry `config.sni_endpoint`; undocumented. Same `### domain config` block as hostname.

schema-discover-heroku.md § `apps[]` (REQUIRED): every Discover output carries one apps[] row per Heroku app. The heroku-nonweb-scaling (seed, after-design) and heroku-workshop (seed, after-arm64-reprice) inventories are hand-authored seeds for Design/Workshop fixtures and carry only resources[] (+ billing_profile). Add an apps[] row for each heroku_app the resources reference (app_name, heroku_generation, generation_action, discovery_status, failure_reason), then remove this entry.

schema-discover-heroku.md § `metadata` (REQUIRED). The heroku-workshop seed and after-arm64-reprice inventories have no metadata block at all (migration_id/skill on the root only). Add metadata (report_date, discovery_sources, confidence) to both goldens, then remove this entry.
